tasks.label: Build Logitech MX Homey plugin
tasks.command: npm.cmd --prefix logi-homey-actions install; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { npm.cmd --prefix logi-homey-actions run build }

tasks.label: Build both integration apps
tasks.command: npm.cmd --prefix logi-homey-actions run build; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { & "$env:APPDATA\npm\homey.cmd" app build --path homey-app/com.homey.logitechmx }

tasks.label: Package plugin and lint Homey app
tasks.command: npm.cmd --prefix logi-homey-actions run build:pack; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { Push-Location homey-app/com.homey.logitechmx; npm.cmd run lint; Pop-Location }

tasks.label: Recheck plugin pack and Homey lint
tasks.command: npm.cmd --prefix logi-homey-actions run build:pack; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { Push-Location homey-app/com.homey.logitechmx; npm.cmd run lint -- --fix; Pop-Location }

tasks.label: Recheck plugin pack and Homey lint
tasks.command: npm.cmd --prefix logi-homey-actions run build:pack; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { Push-Location homey-app/com.homey.logitechmx; npm.cmd run lint -- --fix; Pop-Location }

tasks.label: Show Homey TypeScript errors
tasks.command: Push-Location homey-app/com.homey.logitechmx; npm.cmd run build; Pop-Location

tasks.label: Rebuild Homey app after API fix
Final integration build checks
tasks.command: npm.cmd --prefix logi-homey-actions run build:pack; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { Push-Location homey-app/com.homey.logitechmx; npm.cmd run lint; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { & "$env:APPDATA\npm\homey.cmd" app build }; Pop-Location }
